top_concerns: Claim that AR avoids spurious edits is unsupported: GPT-Over. is lower than OmniGen/UltraEdit in several settings; gain comes from GPT-Suc.; no direct preservation metric or tokenizer round-trip error

Confounded comparison: VAREdit trained on 3.92M curated pairs (incl. ImgEdit) vs. older released baselines; no same-data diffusion baseline, no recent strong editors (Step1X-Edit, BAGEL, FLUX Kontext, OmniGen2)
Primary metric is custom GPT-4o-judged GPT-Balance with single run, no variance or human study; CLIP gains small or absent
SAR evidence thin: motivated by one attention heatmap, ablation only 256px/2.2B with small gains (PIE Suc. drops), no layer-placement or extra-capacity controls
Scaling and efficiency claims confounded (codebook dim, training length differ between 2.2B/8.4B; timing setup and resolutions not matched)
